concept.title: Color Lock
concept.premise: Player is trapped in a facility where every door is sealed by a color-lock mechanism. Progress by solving color-based puzzles (mixing, matching, sequencing) to unlock doors and advance through rooms of increasing complexity toward a final multi-color master lock.
